semantics.bootstrap_rule: Root Contract Format bootstrap is resolved before canonical/json/**.
semantics.canonical_rule: canonical/json/** contains ordinary canonical contracts/support artifacts only.
semantics.history_rule: Historical/superseded/legacy artifacts cannot compete as active source authority.
semantics.review_rule: Generated review/candidate trees are not active accepted canonical sources until explicit replacement/approval.
semantics.path_rule: Repository layout organizes source discovery but never replaces canonical identity.
semantics.generated_rule: Generated manifests/reports do not become semantic definitions unless explicitly declared by source role.

invariants.rule: Canonical source resolution is deterministic, exact-identity based and provenance-preserving; filesystem location, transport or freshness never silently changes semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: review tree consumed as accepted canonical source without approval
historical artifact competes as active source
root bootstrap treated as ordinary canonical contract
canonical identity inferred from repository path
generated report interpreted as semantic definition without source role
